sentences.text: ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Ms. Saeena Bano For Respondent(s) : Mr. A.R. Choudhary, PP
Mr. Vikas Godara for complainant
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJENDRA PRAKASH SONI Order 15/07/2024 1.

The prayer made in this bail petition filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (for short "the Code") is for grant of bail in connection with crime registered pursuant to first information report number 72/2024 of Police Station Nagori Gate District Jodhpur City East in respect of offence(s) punishable under S ection(s) 384, 406, 389 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860.
2.

entities.text: Police Station Nagori Gate District Jodhpur City East
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel representing the petitioner vehemently urged that the matter has been compromised inter-se between parties and now the complainant is not desirous of continuing the case against the petitioner.
Learned counsel for the petitioner, thus, submits that the petitioner deserves to be released on bail in this case.

[2024:RJ-JD:28826] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-8796/2024]
3. From the other side, learned Public Prosecutor for the State has opposed the bail application on the ground that offence(s) alleged against the petitioner is not compoundable.

sentences.text: the complainant has not disputed the fact of compromise and has expressed his no objection to the petitioner being released on bail.
4. I have given my thoughtful consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and have perused the record carefully.

5. Upon having considered the arguments advanced at the bar, on perusal of record available before court and having regard to facts and circumstances of the case particularly looking to the both the parties have reach at a settlement on some points and settlement document has been verified by the SHO/investigation officer of police station concern.
Settlement document placed on record, clearly states that parties have settled the matter inter-se.
Above fact is verified by the learned counsel for the complainant.
Therefore, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case for grant of indulgence of bail to the petitioners at this stage.
6. Be that as it may, while desisting to make any comment on merits, I feel persuaded to exercise discretion in favour of petitioner for enlarging him on bail.
7. Consequently, the bail application is allowed.

It is ordered that the petitioner Firdosh Jahan D/o Ajmat Ali in F.I.R. No.72/2024, Police Station Nagori Gate, District Jodhpur City East shall be released on bail; provided she furnishes a personal bond of Rs. 1,00,000/- and two surety bonds of Rs. 50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with the stipulation to [2024:RJ-JD:28826] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-8796/2024] appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so and if not required by Jail Authorities in any other case.

entities.text: Police Station Nagori Gate, District Jodhpur City East
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
This order is subject to the condition that accused, within 7 days of her release and sureties, on the day of furnishing bail, will also furnish details of their all bank accounts, with bank and branch name, in shape of an affidavit, and submit legible copy of their Aadhar cards as well as front page of Bank pass book, for smooth recovery of penalty amount, if there arise a need for recovery of penalty under Section 446 Cr.P.C in future.
(RAJENDRA PRAKASH SONI),J 112-suraj/-
